rows.note: Use 仔細 as the all-purpose choice when stressing careful attention to details in a process or task.

example.english: Their painstaking checking of every document meant that no information was missed.
example.traditional: 佢逐份文件都核對得好仔細，冇漏到任何資料。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zuk6 fan6 man4 gin6 dou1 hat6 deoi3 dak1 hou2 zi2 sai3 mou5 lau6 dou3 jam6 ho4 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use 認真 when the emphasis is on conscientious, diligent performance rather than minute detail.

example.english: I was painstaking in preparing this report, and my boss praised me.
example.traditional: 我做呢份報告做得好認真，老闆都讚我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zou6 dak1 hou2 jing6 zan1 lou5 baan2 dou1 zaan3 ngo5

rows.note: Use 用心 when emphasizing the care and effort someone has invested in doing something.

example.english: They put a lot of painstaking care into this birthday cake, even getting the details right.
example.traditional: 佢整呢個生日蛋糕好用心，連細節都整得好靚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zing2 ni1 go3 saang1 jat6 daan6 gou1 hou2 jung6 sam1 lin4 sai3 zit3 dou1 zing2 dak1 hou2 leng3
